newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close firmer despite Dow's slide.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close firmer despite Dow's slide.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed slightly firmer on Thursday and were little affected by a slide on Wall Street overnight. Blue-chip issues rallied on buying from what many participants believed was by public funds, supporting the key market index, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 92.01 points or 0.51 percent to 18,129.31. Its June futures closed 30 points higher at 18,080.
"Despite the Dow's decline, multinationals, especially high-tech issues, rose strongly," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
